```diff
+ /**
+  * Agent - Main component for rendering an AI agent interface
+  *
+  * This component orchestrates the layout and functionality of an AI agent interface,
+  * combining header, input panel, and output display components.
+  */
+ 'use client'
+ 
+ import {useState, useCallback} from 'react'
+ import {toast} from 'sonner'
+ import {AgentHeader} from './agent-header'
+ import {InputPanel} from './agent-input-panel'
+ import {OutputPanel} from './agent-output-panel'
+ import {MobileOutputPanel} from './agent-mobile-output-panel'
+ import {useMediaQuery} from '../../hooks/use-media-query'
+ import type {AgentType} from '../../lib/types'
+ 
+ // Default model parameters
+ const DEFAULT_PARAMS = {
+   maxTokens: 700,
+   temperature: 0.7,
+   topP: 1,
+   frequencyPenalty: 0,
+   presencePenalty: 0,
+ }
+ 
+ interface AgentProps {
+   agentTypes: AgentType[]
+   defaultAgent?: string
+   onAgentChange?: (agentId: string) =&gt; void
+   onSubmit: (agentId: string, inputs: Record&lt;string, string&gt;, params: any) =&gt; Promise&lt;any&gt;
+   customHeader?: React.ReactNode
+   customFooter?: React.ReactNode
+   className?: string
+ }
+ 
+ export function Agent({
+   agentTypes,
+   defaultAgent,
+   onAgentChange,
+   onSubmit,
+   customHeader,
+   customFooter,
+   className,
+ }: AgentProps) {
+   // State management
+   const [inputs, setInputs] = useState&lt;Record&lt;string, string&gt;&gt;({})
+   const [selectedExampleIndex, setSelectedExampleIndex] = useState&lt;number | null&gt;(null)
+   const [output, setOutput] = useState('')
+   const [parsedOutput, setParsedOutput] = useState&lt;any&gt;(null)
+   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
+   const [selectedAgent, setSelectedAgent] = useState&lt;string&gt;(defaultAgent || agentTypes[0].id)
+   const [params, setParams] = useState(DEFAULT_PARAMS)
+   const [inputHistory, setInputHistory] = useState&lt;Record&lt;string, string[]&gt;&gt;({})
+   const [outputDrawerOpen, setOutputDrawerOpen] = useState(false)
+ 
+   // Responsive design
+   const isMobile = useMediaQuery('(max-width: 768px)')
+   const selectedAgentDetails = agentTypes.find((agent) =&gt; agent.id === selectedAgent)
+   const currentAgentHistory = inputHistory[selectedAgent] || []
+ 
+   // Input management
+   const handleInputChange = useCallback((fieldName: string, value: string) =&gt; {
+     setInputs((prev) =&gt; ({...prev, [fieldName]: value}))
+   }, [])
+ 
+   const resetState = useCallback(() =&gt; {
+     setInputs({})
+     setOutput('')
+     setLoading(false)
+     setParsedOutput(null)
+     setParams(DEFAULT_PARAMS)
+     setSelectedExampleIndex(null)
+   }, [])
+ 
+   const handleAgentChange = useCallback(
+     (newAgent: string) =&gt; {
+       setSelectedAgent(newAgent)
+       resetState()
+       onAgentChange?.(newAgent)
+     },
+     [resetState, onAgentChange]
+   )
+ 
+   const handleExampleSelect = useCallback((example: Record&lt;string, string&gt;, index: number) =&gt; {
+     setInputs(example)
+     setSelectedExampleIndex(index)
+   }, [])
+ 
+   const handleHistorySelect = useCallback((historyItem: string) =&gt; {
+     try {
+       const parsedItem = JSON.parse(historyItem) as Record&lt;string, string&gt;
+       setInputs(parsedItem)
+       toast.success('Loaded from history')
+     } catch (error) {
+       toast.error('Failed to load history item')
+     }
+   }, [])
+ 
+   const handleCopyInput = useCallback(() =&gt; {
+     navigator.clipboard.writeText(JSON.stringify(inputs, null, 2))
+     toast.success('Copied to clipboard')
+   }, [inputs])
+ 
+   const handleClearInput = useCallback(() =&gt; {
+     setInputs({})
+     toast.success('Input cleared')
+   }, [])
+ 
+   // Submission handling
+   const handleInputSubmit = useCallback(async () =&gt; {
+     if (!selectedAgentDetails) return
+ 
+     if (Object.values(inputs).every((v) =&gt; v.trim() === '')) {
+       toast.error('Please enter an input or select an example')
+       return
+     }
+ 
+     setLoading(true)
+     setOutputDrawerOpen(true)
+ 
+     try {
+       const result = await onSubmit(selectedAgent, inputs, params)
+ 
+       if (typeof result === 'string') {
+         setOutput(result)
+         // Attempt to parse as JSON
+         try {
+           setParsedOutput(JSON.parse(result))
+         } catch {
+           setParsedOutput(null)
+         }
+       } else {
+         setOutput(result?.output || JSON.stringify(result))
+         setParsedOutput(result)
+       }
+ 
+       // Update history
+       setInputHistory((prev) =&gt; ({
+         ...prev,
+         [selectedAgent]: [JSON.stringify(inputs), ...(prev[selectedAgent] || [])],
+       }))
+     } catch (error: any) {
+       toast.error('Failed to process request')
+       console.error(error)
+       setOutput(error?.message || 'Unknown error occurred')
+       setParsedOutput({error: true, message: error?.message})
+     } finally {
+       setLoading(false)
+     }
+   }, [selectedAgent, selectedAgentDetails, inputs, params, onSubmit])
+ 
+   if (!selectedAgentDetails) {
+     return &lt;div&gt;No agent selected&lt;/div&gt;
+   }
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className={&#96;flex flex-col h-full overflow-hidden ${className}&#96;}&gt;
+       {customHeader || (
+         &lt;AgentHeader
+           selectedAgent={selectedAgent}
+           onAgentChange={handleAgentChange}
+           onCopyInput={handleCopyInput}
+           onClearInput={handleClearInput}
+           hasInput={Object.values(inputs).some((v) =&gt; v.trim())}
+           agentTypes={agentTypes}
+         /&gt;
+       )}
+ 
+       &lt;div className='flex-1 flex flex-col min-h-0 pb-4 bg-muted overflow-hidden relative'&gt;
+         &lt;h2 className='hidden md:block text-[9px] font-medium text-neutral-400 px-2 sm:px-4 pt-4'&gt;
+           Input
+         &lt;/h2&gt;
+ 
+         &lt;div className='flex-1 flex flex-col md:flex-row min-h-0 w-full py-2'&gt;
+           &lt;InputPanel
+             inputs={inputs}
+             resetState={resetState}
+             onInputChange={handleInputChange}
+             selectedAgent={selectedAgentDetails}
+             onExampleSelect={handleExampleSelect}
+             selectedExampleIndex={selectedExampleIndex}
+             examplePrompts={selectedAgentDetails.examples || []}
+             inputHistory={currentAgentHistory}
+             loading={loading}
+             handleInputSubmit={handleInputSubmit}
+             handleHistorySelect={handleHistorySelect}
+             isMobile={isMobile}
+           /&gt;
+ 
+           {isMobile ? (
+             &lt;MobileOutputPanel
+               selectedAgent={selectedAgentDetails}
+               loading={loading}
+               outputDrawerOpen={outputDrawerOpen}
+               setOutputDrawerOpen={setOutputDrawerOpen}&gt;
+               &lt;OutputPanel
+                 selectedAgent={selectedAgentDetails}
+                 loading={loading}
+                 output={output}
+                 parsedOutput={parsedOutput}
+               /&gt;
+             &lt;/MobileOutputPanel&gt;
+           ) : (
+             &lt;OutputPanel
+               selectedAgent={selectedAgentDetails}
+               loading={loading}
+               output={output}
+               parsedOutput={parsedOutput}
+             /&gt;
+           )}
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+       {customFooter &amp;&amp; &lt;div className='mt-auto'&gt;{customFooter}&lt;/div&gt;}
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   )
+ }
+ 
```

```diff
+ /**
+  * OutputPanel - Component for displaying agent outputs
+  *
+  * This component displays the output from an AI agent, providing various
+  * display formats and loading states.
+  */
+ 'use client'
+ 
+ import {useState} from 'react'
+ import {motion} from 'motion/react'
+ import {Button} from '@/components/ui/button'
+ import {Card} from '@/components/ui/card'
+ import {Copy, Code, AlignLeft} from 'lucide-react'
+ import {LoadingState} from './agent-states'
+ import {MarkdownRenderer} from './markdown-renderer'
+ import {AgentOutputCards} from './agent-output-cards'
+ import {CompletionIndicator} from './completion-indicator'
+ import {TokenCounter} from './token-counter'
+ import {cn} from '@/lib/utils'
+ import type {AgentType} from '../../lib/types'
+ 
+ interface OutputPanelProps {
+   selectedAgent: AgentType
+   loading: boolean
+   output: string
+   parsedOutput: any
+   className?: string
+ }
+ 
+ export function OutputPanel({
+   selectedAgent,
+   loading,
+   output,
+   parsedOutput,
+   className,
+ }: OutputPanelProps) {
+   const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState&lt;'formatted' | 'raw' | 'json'&gt;('formatted')
+   const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false)
+ 
+   // Handle copying output to clipboard
+   const handleCopyOutput = () =&gt; {
+     navigator.clipboard.writeText(output)
+     setCopied(true)
+     setTimeout(() =&gt; setCopied(false), 2000)
+   }
+ 
+   // Determine if output should be rendered as JSON
+   const hasJsonOutput = parsedOutput &amp;&amp; typeof parsedOutput === 'object'
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className={cn('flex-1 flex flex-col min-w-0 ml-0 md:ml-4 h-full', className)}&gt;
+       &lt;div className='flex justify-between items-center mb-2 pt-4 px-2 md:px-0'&gt;
+         &lt;h2 className='text-[9px] font-medium text-neutral-400'&gt;Output&lt;/h2&gt;
+ 
+         {output &amp;&amp; !loading &amp;&amp; (
+           &lt;div className='flex items-center gap-1'&gt;
+             &lt;TokenCounter text={output} /&gt;
+ 
+             &lt;Button
+               variant='ghost'
+               size='icon'
+               className='h-6 w-6 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground'
+               onClick={handleCopyOutput}&gt;
+               &lt;Copy className='h-3.5 w-3.5' /&gt;
+               &lt;span className='sr-only'&gt;Copy output&lt;/span&gt;
+             &lt;/Button&gt;
+ 
+             {hasJsonOutput &amp;&amp; (
+               &lt;&gt;
+                 &lt;Button
+                   variant={viewMode === 'formatted' ? 'default' : 'ghost'}
+                   size='icon'
+                   className='h-6 w-6'
+                   onClick={() =&gt; setViewMode('formatted')}&gt;
+                   &lt;AlignLeft className='h-3.5 w-3.5' /&gt;
+                   &lt;span className='sr-only'&gt;View formatted&lt;/span&gt;
+                 &lt;/Button&gt;
+ 
+                 &lt;Button
+                   variant={viewMode === 'json' ? 'default' : 'ghost'}
+                   size='icon'
+                   className='h-6 w-6'
+                   onClick={() =&gt; setViewMode('json')}&gt;
+                   &lt;Code className='h-3.5 w-3.5' /&gt;
+                   &lt;span className='sr-only'&gt;View JSON&lt;/span&gt;
+                 &lt;/Button&gt;
+               &lt;/&gt;
+             )}
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         )}
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+       &lt;Card className='flex-1 min-h-0 p-4 overflow-y-auto bg-white dark:bg-gray-950 border border-neutral-200 dark:border-neutral-800 rounded-xl shadow-sm'&gt;
+         {loading ? (
+           &lt;LoadingState agent={selectedAgent} /&gt;
+         ) : output ? (
+           &lt;motion.div
+             initial={{opacity: 0}}
+             animate={{opacity: 1}}
+             transition={{duration: 0.3}}
+             className='w-full h-full'&gt;
+             {viewMode === 'formatted' &amp;&amp; hasJsonOutput ? (
+               &lt;AgentOutputCards output={parsedOutput} agentType={selectedAgent} /&gt;
+             ) : viewMode === 'json' &amp;&amp; hasJsonOutput ? (
+               &lt;pre className='text-xs overflow-auto p-4 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-900 rounded-lg'&gt;
+                 {JSON.stringify(parsedOutput, null, 2)}
+               &lt;/pre&gt;
+             ) : (
+               &lt;MarkdownRenderer content={output} /&gt;
+             )}
+ 
+             &lt;CompletionIndicator completed={true} /&gt;
+           &lt;/motion.div&gt;
+         ) : (
+           &lt;div className='flex items-center justify-center h-full text-muted-foreground text-sm'&gt;
+             Agent output will appear here
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         )}
+       &lt;/Card&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   )
+ }
+
```

```diff
+ /**
+  * InputPanel - Component for rendering agent input fields
+  *
+  * This component provides a form interface for configuring and submitting
+  * agent requests, including input fields, examples, and action buttons.
+  */
+ 'use client'
+ 
+ import {useState} from 'react'
+ import {motion} from 'motion/react'
+ import {Button} from '@/components/ui/button'
+ import {Card} from '@/components/ui/card'
+ import {Input} from '@/components/ui/input'
+ import {Textarea} from '@/components/ui/textarea'
+ import {Separator} from '@/components/ui/separator'
+ import {HistoryIcon, PlayIcon, RotateCcw, TimerReset} from 'lucide-react'
+ import {
+   DropdownMenu,
+   DropdownMenuContent,
+   DropdownMenuItem,
+   DropdownMenuTrigger,
+ } from '@/components/ui/dropdown-menu'
+ import {cn} from '@/lib/utils'
+ import type {AgentType} from '../../lib/types'
+ 
+ interface InputPanelProps {
+   inputs: Record&lt;string, string&gt;
+   onInputChange: (field: string, value: string) =&gt; void
+   selectedAgent: AgentType
+   examplePrompts: Array&lt;Record&lt;string, string&gt;&gt;
+   selectedExampleIndex: number | null
+   onExampleSelect: (example: Record&lt;string, string&gt;, index: number) =&gt; void
+   resetState: () =&gt; void
+   inputHistory?: string[]
+   loading?: boolean
+   handleInputSubmit?: () =&gt; void
+   handleHistorySelect?: (historyItem: string) =&gt; void
+   isMobile?: boolean
+   children?: React.ReactNode
+ }
+ 
+ export function InputPanel({
+   inputs,
+   onInputChange,
+   selectedAgent,
+   examplePrompts,
+   selectedExampleIndex,
+   onExampleSelect,
+   resetState,
+   inputHistory = [],
+   loading = false,
+   handleInputSubmit,
+   handleHistorySelect,
+   isMobile = false,
+   children,
+ }: InputPanelProps) {
+   const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState&lt;'input' | 'examples'&gt;('input')
+ 
+   // Determine which tab to show by default
+   const hasExamples = examplePrompts &amp;&amp; examplePrompts.length &gt; 0
+   const hasTabs = hasExamples
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className='flex-1 md:max-w-md w-full flex flex-col min-h-0 px-2 sm:px-4'&gt;
+       {hasTabs &amp;&amp; (
+         &lt;div className='flex mb-2'&gt;
+           &lt;Button
+             variant={activeTab === 'input' ? 'default' : 'ghost'}
+             size='sm'
+             className='text-xs py-1 h-7'
+             onClick={() =&gt; setActiveTab('input')}&gt;
+             Input
+           &lt;/Button&gt;
+           {hasExamples &amp;&amp; (
+             &lt;Button
+               variant={activeTab === 'examples' ? 'default' : 'ghost'}
+               size='sm'
+               className='text-xs py-1 h-7'
+               onClick={() =&gt; setActiveTab('examples')}&gt;
+               Examples
+             &lt;/Button&gt;
+           )}
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       )}
+ 
+       &lt;Card className='flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto bg-white dark:bg-gray-950 border border-neutral-200 dark:border-neutral-800 rounded-xl shadow-sm'&gt;
+         &lt;div className='p-4 space-y-4'&gt;
+           {activeTab === 'input' ? (
+             &lt;InputFields
+               inputs={inputs}
+               onInputChange={onInputChange}
+               selectedAgent={selectedAgent}
+             /&gt;
+           ) : activeTab === 'examples' &amp;&amp; hasExamples ? (
+             &lt;Examples
+               examples={examplePrompts}
+               selectedIndex={selectedExampleIndex}
+               onSelect={onExampleSelect}
+             /&gt;
+           ) : null}
+ 
+           {children || (
+             &lt;ActionButtons
+               inputs={inputs}
+               loading={loading}
+               isMobile={isMobile}
+               resetState={resetState}
+               inputHistory={inputHistory}
+               handleInputSubmit={handleInputSubmit}
+               handleHistorySelect={handleHistorySelect}
+             /&gt;
+           )}
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/Card&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   )
+ }
+ 
+ function InputFields({
+   inputs,
+   onInputChange,
+   selectedAgent,
+ }: {
+   inputs: Record&lt;string, string&gt;
+   onInputChange: (field: string, value: string) =&gt; void
+   selectedAgent: AgentType
+ }) {
+   if (!selectedAgent || !selectedAgent.inputFields) {
+     return (
+       &lt;div className='text-center text-muted-foreground p-4'&gt;
+         No input fields defined for this agent
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     )
+   }
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className='space-y-4'&gt;
+       {selectedAgent.inputFields.map((field) =&gt; {
+         const fieldValue = inputs[field.name] || ''
+ 
+         if (field.type === 'textarea') {
+           return (
+             &lt;div key={field.name} className='space-y-2'&gt;
+               &lt;label className='block text-xs font-medium text-neutral-700 dark:text-neutral-300'&gt;
+                 {field.label || field.name}
+               &lt;/label&gt;
+               &lt;Textarea
+                 value={fieldValue}
+                 onChange={(e) =&gt; onInputChange(field.name, e.target.value)}
+                 placeholder={field.placeholder || ''}
+                 className={cn(
+                   'min-h-24 resize-y text-sm',
+                   fieldValue ? 'border-blue-300 dark:border-blue-700' : ''
+                 )}
+               /&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           )
+         }
+ 
+         return (
+           &lt;div key={field.name} className='space-y-2'&gt;
+             &lt;label className='block text-xs font-medium text-neutral-700 dark:text-neutral-300'&gt;
+               {field.label || field.name}
+             &lt;/label&gt;
+             &lt;Input
+               type={field.type || 'text'}
+               value={fieldValue}
+               onChange={(e) =&gt; onInputChange(field.name, e.target.value)}
+               placeholder={field.placeholder || ''}
+               className={cn('text-sm', fieldValue ? 'border-blue-300 dark:border-blue-700' : '')}
+             /&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         )
+       })}
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   )
+ }
+ 
+ function Examples({
+   examples,
+   selectedIndex,
+   onSelect,
+ }: {
+   examples: Array&lt;Record&lt;string, string&gt;&gt;
+   selectedIndex: number | null
+   onSelect: (example: Record&lt;string, string&gt;, index: number) =&gt; void
+ }) {
+   if (!examples || !examples.length) {
+     return &lt;div className='text-center text-muted-foreground p-4'&gt;No examples available&lt;/div&gt;
+   }
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className='space-y-3'&gt;
+       {examples.map((example, index) =&gt; {
+         // Extract a title from the example if available, or use a default
+         const title =
+           example.title ||
+           example.name ||
+           example.prompt?.substring(0, 30) ||
+           &#96;Example ${index + 1}&#96;
+ 
+         return (
+           &lt;motion.div
+             key={index}
+             whileHover={{y: -2}}
+             transition={{type: 'spring', stiffness: 500, damping: 30}}&gt;
+             &lt;Button
+               variant={selectedIndex === index ? 'default' : 'outline'}
+               className={cn(
+                 'w-full text-left justify-start text-sm p-3 h-auto font-normal',
+                 selectedIndex === index
+                   ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-900 hover:bg-blue-200 border-blue-300'
+                   : ''
+               )}
+               onClick={() =&gt; onSelect(example, index)}&gt;
+               {title}
+             &lt;/Button&gt;
+           &lt;/motion.div&gt;
+         )
+       })}
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   )
+ }
+ 
+ export function ActionButtons({
+   inputs,
+   loading,
+   isMobile,
+   resetState,
+   inputHistory = [],
+   handleInputSubmit,
+   handleHistorySelect,
+   mobileReOpenOutputDrawer,
+ }: {
+   inputs: Record&lt;string, string&gt;
+   loading?: boolean
+   isMobile?: boolean
+   resetState: () =&gt; void
+   inputHistory?: string[]
+   handleInputSubmit?: () =&gt; void
+   handleHistorySelect?: (historyItem: string) =&gt; void
+   mobileReOpenOutputDrawer?: () =&gt; void
+ }) {
+   const hasHistory = inputHistory &amp;&amp; inputHistory.length &gt; 0
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className='flex items-center justify-between pt-2'&gt;
+       &lt;div className='flex items-center gap-2'&gt;
+         &lt;Button
+           variant='outline'
+           size='sm'
+           onClick={resetState}
+           disabled={loading}
+           className='h-8 text-xs'&gt;
+           &lt;RotateCcw className='mr-1 h-3 w-3' /&gt;
+           Reset
+         &lt;/Button&gt;
+ 
+         {hasHistory &amp;&amp; handleHistorySelect &amp;&amp; (
+           &lt;DropdownMenu&gt;
+             &lt;DropdownMenuTrigger asChild&gt;
+               &lt;Button variant='outline' size='sm' className='h-8 text-xs' disabled={loading}&gt;
+                 &lt;HistoryIcon className='mr-1 h-3 w-3' /&gt;
+                 History
+               &lt;/Button&gt;
+             &lt;/DropdownMenuTrigger&gt;
+             &lt;DropdownMenuContent align='end' className='w-60'&gt;
+               {inputHistory.slice(0, 5).map((item, index) =&gt; {
+                 // Try to extract a meaningful label from the history item
+                 let label
+                 try {
+                   const parsed = JSON.parse(item)
+                   label =
+                     parsed.title ||
+                     parsed.prompt?.substring(0, 20) ||
+                     Object.values(parsed)[0]?.substring?.(0, 20) ||
+                     &#96;Input ${index + 1}&#96;
+ 
+                   if (label.length &gt; 20) {
+                     label = label.substring(0, 20) + '...'
+                   }
+                 } catch {
+                   label = &#96;Input ${index + 1}&#96;
+                 }
+ 
+                 return (
+                   &lt;DropdownMenuItem
+                     key={index}
+                     onClick={() =&gt; handleHistorySelect(item)}
+                     className='cursor-pointer'&gt;
+                     {label}
+                   &lt;/DropdownMenuItem&gt;
+                 )
+               })}
+             &lt;/DropdownMenuContent&gt;
+           &lt;/DropdownMenu&gt;
+         )}
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+       &lt;div className='flex items-center gap-2'&gt;
+         {isMobile &amp;&amp; mobileReOpenOutputDrawer &amp;&amp; (
+           &lt;Button
+             variant='outline'
+             size='sm'
+             onClick={mobileReOpenOutputDrawer}
+             className='h-8 text-xs'
+             disabled={loading}&gt;
+             View Results
+           &lt;/Button&gt;
+         )}
+ 
+         &lt;Button onClick={handleInputSubmit} disabled={loading} className='h-8 text-xs' size='sm'&gt;
+           {loading ? (
+             &lt;div className='flex items-center gap-1'&gt;
+               &lt;span className='h-3 w-3 animate-spin rounded-full border-2 border-white border-t-transparent' /&gt;
+               &lt;span&gt;Processing...&lt;/span&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           ) : (
+             &lt;&gt;
+               &lt;PlayIcon className='mr-1 h-3 w-3' /&gt;
+               Execute
+             &lt;/&gt;
+           )}
+         &lt;/Button&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   )
+ }
+
```

```diff
+ /**
+  * MobileOutputPanel - Responsive drawer for mobile agent outputs
+  *
+  * This component provides a mobile-friendly drawer interface for viewing
+  * agent outputs on smaller screens.
+  */
+ 'use client'
+ 
+ import {useEffect} from 'react'
+ import {motion, AnimatePresence} from 'motion/react'
+ import {X} from 'lucide-react'
+ import {Button} from '@/components/ui/button'
+ import type {AgentType} from '../../lib/types'
+ 
+ interface MobileOutputPanelProps {
+   selectedAgent: AgentType
+   loading: boolean
+   outputDrawerOpen: boolean
+   setOutputDrawerOpen: (open: boolean) =&gt; void
+   children: React.ReactNode
+   className?: string
+ }
+ 
+ export function MobileOutputPanel({
+   selectedAgent,
+   loading,
+   outputDrawerOpen,
+   setOutputDrawerOpen,
+   children,
+   className = '',
+ }: MobileOutputPanelProps) {
+   // Close the drawer when pressing Escape
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) =&gt; {
+       if (e.key === 'Escape' &amp;&amp; outputDrawerOpen) {
+         setOutputDrawerOpen(false)
+       }
+     }
+ 
+     window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown)
+     return () =&gt; window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown)
+   }, [outputDrawerOpen, setOutputDrawerOpen])
+ 
+   // Prevent body scrolling when drawer is open
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     if (outputDrawerOpen) {
+       document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'
+     } else {
+       document.body.style.overflow = ''
+     }
+     return () =&gt; {
+       document.body.style.overflow = ''
+     }
+   }, [outputDrawerOpen])
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;AnimatePresence&gt;
+       {outputDrawerOpen &amp;&amp; (
+         &lt;&gt;
+           {/* Backdrop */}
+           &lt;motion.div
+             initial={{opacity: 0}}
+             animate={{opacity: 0.5}}
+             exit={{opacity: 0}}
+             transition={{duration: 0.2}}
+             className='fixed inset-0 bg-black z-40'
+             onClick={() =&gt; setOutputDrawerOpen(false)}
+           /&gt;
+ 
+           {/* Drawer */}
+           &lt;motion.div
+             initial={{y: '100%'}}
+             animate={{y: 0}}
+             exit={{y: '100%'}}
+             transition={{
+               type: 'spring',
+               damping: 30,
+               stiffness: 300,
+             }}
+             className={&#96;fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-[80vh] z-50 bg-background p-4 rounded-t-2xl shadow-lg ${className}&#96;}&gt;
+             &lt;div className='absolute top-2 right-2'&gt;
+               &lt;Button
+                 variant='ghost'
+                 size='icon'
+                 className='h-8 w-8'
+                 onClick={() =&gt; setOutputDrawerOpen(false)}&gt;
+                 &lt;X className='h-4 w-4' /&gt;
+                 &lt;span className='sr-only'&gt;Close&lt;/span&gt;
+               &lt;/Button&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+             &lt;div className='flex flex-col h-full pt-4'&gt;
+               &lt;div className='text-center mb-4'&gt;
+                 &lt;div className='w-12 h-1 bg-muted-foreground/20 mx-auto rounded-full mb-4' /&gt;
+                 &lt;h3 className='text-sm font-medium'&gt;
+                   {selectedAgent.name} {loading ? 'Processing...' : 'Results'}
+                 &lt;/h3&gt;
+               &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+               &lt;div className='flex-1 overflow-auto -mx-4 px-4'&gt;{children}&lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           &lt;/motion.div&gt;
+         &lt;/&gt;
+       )}
+     &lt;/AnimatePresence&gt;
+   )
+ }
```

```diff
+ /**
+  * AgentOutputCards - Component for rendering formatted agent outputs
+  *
+  * This component takes structured agent outputs and displays them in a
+  * visually appealing card format, adapting to different agent types and
+  * output formats.
+  */
+ 'use client'
+ 
+ import {useMemo} from 'react'
+ import {motion} from 'motion/react'
+ import {Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle} from '@/components/ui/card'
+ import {Badge} from '@/components/ui/badge'
+ import {CircleCheck, CircleAlert, ExternalLink, ArrowRight} from 'lucide-react'
+ import {MarkdownRenderer} from './markdown-renderer'
+ import {cn} from '@/lib/utils'
+ import type {AgentType} from '../../lib/types'
+ 
+ interface AgentOutputCardsProps {
+   output: any
+   agentType: AgentType
+   className?: string
+ }
+ 
+ export function AgentOutputCards({output, agentType, className = ''}: AgentOutputCardsProps) {
+   // Determine the appropriate card layout based on agent type and output format
+   const renderContent = useMemo(() =&gt; {
+     if (!output) return null
+ 
+     // Handle error states
+     if (output.error) {
+       return &lt;ErrorCard message={output.message || 'An unknown error occurred'} /&gt;
+     }
+ 
+     // Different agent types might have different output structures
+     switch (agentType.id) {
+       case 'summarizer':
+         return &lt;SummaryCard summary={output.summary} points={output.key_points} /&gt;
+ 
+       case 'analyzer':
+         return &lt;AnalysisCard analysis={output} /&gt;
+ 
+       case 'search-agent':
+         return &lt;SearchResultsCard results={output.results} query={output.query} /&gt;
+ 
+       case 'chat-agent':
+         return &lt;ChatResponseCard response={output.response || output} /&gt;
+ 
+       // Default card for generic outputs
+       default:
+         return &lt;GenericOutputCard output={output} /&gt;
+     }
+   }, [output, agentType])
+ 
+   if (!output) {
+     return &lt;div className='text-center text-muted-foreground'&gt;No output available&lt;/div&gt;
+   }
+ 
+   return &lt;div className={cn('space-y-4', className)}&gt;{renderContent}&lt;/div&gt;
+ }
+ 
+ function ErrorCard({message}: {message: string}) {
+   return (
+     &lt;motion.div
+       initial={{opacity: 0, y: 10}}
+       animate={{opacity: 1, y: 0}}
+       transition={{duration: 0.3}}&gt;
+       &lt;Card className='border-red-200 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/20 dark:border-red-900/50'&gt;
+         &lt;CardHeader className='pb-2'&gt;
+           &lt;CardTitle className='text-sm font-medium text-red-800 dark:text-red-400 flex items-center'&gt;
+             &lt;CircleAlert className='w-4 h-4 mr-2' /&gt;
+             Error
+           &lt;/CardTitle&gt;
+         &lt;/CardHeader&gt;
+         &lt;CardContent className='text-sm text-red-700 dark:text-red-300'&gt;{message}&lt;/CardContent&gt;
+       &lt;/Card&gt;
+     &lt;/motion.div&gt;
+   )
+ }
+ 
+ function SummaryCard({summary, points = []}: {summary: string; points?: string[]}) {
+   return (
+     &lt;motion.div
+       initial={{opacity: 0, y: 10}}
+       animate={{opacity: 1, y: 0}}
+       transition={{duration: 0.3}}&gt;
+       &lt;Card&gt;
+         &lt;CardHeader className='pb-2'&gt;
+           &lt;CardTitle className='text-sm font-medium'&gt;Summary&lt;/CardTitle&gt;
+         &lt;/CardHeader&gt;
+         &lt;CardContent className='space-y-4'&gt;
+           &lt;div className='text-sm'&gt;
+             &lt;MarkdownRenderer content={summary} /&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+           {points &amp;&amp; points.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; (
+             &lt;div className='space-y-2'&gt;
+               &lt;h4 className='text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground'&gt;Key Points&lt;/h4&gt;
+               &lt;ul className='space-y-1 text-sm'&gt;
+                 {points.map((point, i) =&gt; (
+                   &lt;li key={i} className='flex items-start'&gt;
+                     &lt;CircleCheck className='w-4 h-4 mr-2 text-green-500 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0' /&gt;
+                     &lt;span&gt;{point}&lt;/span&gt;
+                   &lt;/li&gt;
+                 ))}
+               &lt;/ul&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           )}
+         &lt;/CardContent&gt;
+       &lt;/Card&gt;
+     &lt;/motion.div&gt;
+   )
+ }
+ 
+ function AnalysisCard({analysis}: {analysis: any}) {
+   // Handle different analysis result formats
+   const insights = analysis.insights || analysis.findings || []
+   const recommendations = analysis.recommendations || []
+   const sentiment = analysis.sentiment || analysis.tone
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;motion.div
+       initial={{opacity: 0, y: 10}}
+       animate={{opacity: 1, y: 0}}
+       transition={{duration: 0.3}}
+       className='space-y-4'&gt;
+       {analysis.summary &amp;&amp; (
+         &lt;Card&gt;
+           &lt;CardHeader className='pb-2'&gt;
+             &lt;CardTitle className='text-sm font-medium'&gt;Analysis Summary&lt;/CardTitle&gt;
+             {sentiment &amp;&amp; (
+               &lt;Badge
+                 className={cn(
+                   sentiment.toLowerCase().includes('positive')
+                     ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-800'
+                     : sentiment.toLowerCase().includes('negative')
+                       ? 'bg-red-100 text-red-800'
+                       : 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800'
+                 )}&gt;
+                 {sentiment}
+               &lt;/Badge&gt;
+             )}
+           &lt;/CardHeader&gt;
+           &lt;CardContent className='text-sm'&gt;
+             &lt;MarkdownRenderer content={analysis.summary} /&gt;
+           &lt;/CardContent&gt;
+         &lt;/Card&gt;
+       )}
+ 
+       {insights.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; (
+         &lt;Card&gt;
+           &lt;CardHeader className='pb-2'&gt;
+             &lt;CardTitle className='text-sm font-medium'&gt;Key Insights&lt;/CardTitle&gt;
+           &lt;/CardHeader&gt;
+           &lt;CardContent&gt;
+             &lt;ul className='space-y-2 text-sm'&gt;
+               {insights.map((insight: string, i: number) =&gt; (
+                 &lt;li key={i} className='border-l-2 border-blue-500 pl-3 py-1'&gt;
+                   {insight}
+                 &lt;/li&gt;
+               ))}
+             &lt;/ul&gt;
+           &lt;/CardContent&gt;
+         &lt;/Card&gt;
+       )}
+ 
+       {recommendations.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; (
+         &lt;Card&gt;
+           &lt;CardHeader className='pb-2'&gt;
+             &lt;CardTitle className='text-sm font-medium'&gt;Recommendations&lt;/CardTitle&gt;
+           &lt;/CardHeader&gt;
+           &lt;CardContent&gt;
+             &lt;ul className='space-y-2 text-sm'&gt;
+               {recommendations.map((rec: string, i: number) =&gt; (
+                 &lt;li key={i} className='flex items-start'&gt;
+                   &lt;ArrowRight className='w-4 h-4 mr-2 text-blue-500 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0' /&gt;
+                   &lt;span&gt;{rec}&lt;/span&gt;
+                 &lt;/li&gt;
+               ))}
+             &lt;/ul&gt;
+           &lt;/CardContent&gt;
+         &lt;/Card&gt;
+       )}
+     &lt;/motion.div&gt;
+   )
+ }
+ 
+ function SearchResultsCard({results = [], query = ''}: {results: any[]; query: string}) {
+   if (!results.length) {
+     return (
+       &lt;Card&gt;
+         &lt;CardContent className='p-4 text-center text-muted-foreground'&gt;
+           No results found for "{query}"
+         &lt;/CardContent&gt;
+       &lt;/Card&gt;
+     )
+   }
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;motion.div
+       initial={{opacity: 0}}
+       animate={{opacity: 1}}
+       transition={{duration: 0.3}}
+       className='space-y-3'&gt;
+       {query &amp;&amp; (
+         &lt;div className='text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-2'&gt;
+           Search results for: &lt;span className='font-medium'&gt;{query}&lt;/span&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       )}
+ 
+       {results.map((result, index) =&gt; (
+         &lt;motion.div
+           key={index}
+           initial={{opacity: 0, y: 10}}
+           animate={{opacity: 1, y: 0}}
+           transition={{duration: 0.3, delay: index * 0.05}}&gt;
+           &lt;Card className='overflow-hidden'&gt;
+             &lt;CardHeader className='p-3'&gt;
+               &lt;CardTitle className='text-sm font-medium flex items-center justify-between'&gt;
+                 &lt;div className='truncate'&gt;{result.title}&lt;/div&gt;
+                 {result.url &amp;&amp; (
+                   &lt;a
+                     href={result.url}
+                     target='_blank'
+                     rel='noopener noreferrer'
+                     className='text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground ml-2'&gt;
+                     &lt;ExternalLink className='w-3.5 h-3.5' /&gt;
+                   &lt;/a&gt;
+                 )}
+               &lt;/CardTitle&gt;
+             &lt;/CardHeader&gt;
+             &lt;CardContent className='px-3 pb-3 text-xs'&gt;
+               &lt;div className='line-clamp-3'&gt;{result.snippet || result.description}&lt;/div&gt;
+               {result.metadata &amp;&amp; (
+                 &lt;div className='mt-2 flex items-center gap-2 text-muted-foreground'&gt;
+                   {result.metadata.date &amp;&amp; &lt;span className='text-xs'&gt;{result.metadata.date}&lt;/span&gt;}
+                   {result.metadata.source &amp;&amp; (
+                     &lt;Badge variant='outline' className='text-[10px] h-4'&gt;
+                       {result.metadata.source}
+                     &lt;/Badge&gt;
+                   )}
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+               )}
+             &lt;/CardContent&gt;
+           &lt;/Card&gt;
+         &lt;/motion.div&gt;
+       ))}
+     &lt;/motion.div&gt;
+   )
+ }
+ 
+ function ChatResponseCard({response}: {response: string | {content: string}}) {
+   const content = typeof response === 'string' ? response : response.content || ''
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;motion.div
+       initial={{opacity: 0, y: 10}}
+       animate={{opacity: 1, y: 0}}
+       transition={{duration: 0.3}}&gt;
+       &lt;Card&gt;
+         &lt;CardContent className='pt-4'&gt;
+           &lt;MarkdownRenderer content={content} /&gt;
+         &lt;/CardContent&gt;
+       &lt;/Card&gt;
+     &lt;/motion.div&gt;
+   )
+ }
+ 
+ function GenericOutputCard({output}: {output: any}) {
+   // Attempt to extract meaningful content from different output formats
+   const content = useMemo(() =&gt; {
+     if (typeof output === 'string') return output
+     if (output.content) return output.content
+     if (output.response) return output.response
+     if (output.result) return output.result
+     if (output.message) return output.message
+     if (output.text) return output.text
+ 
+     // If we can't find a specific field, render the whole object
+     return JSON.stringify(output, null, 2)
+   }, [output])
+ 
+   // Determine if content should be rendered as markdown or pre-formatted
+   const isJsonString =
+     typeof content === 'string' &amp;&amp; content.trim().startsWith('{') &amp;&amp; content.trim().endsWith('}')
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;motion.div
+       initial={{opacity: 0, y: 10}}
+       animate={{opacity: 1, y: 0}}
+       transition={{duration: 0.3}}&gt;
+       &lt;Card&gt;
+         &lt;CardContent className='pt-4'&gt;
+           {isJsonString ? (
+             &lt;pre className='text-xs overflow-auto p-2 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-900 rounded-lg'&gt;
+               {content}
+             &lt;/pre&gt;
+           ) : (
+             &lt;MarkdownRenderer content={content} /&gt;
+           )}
+         &lt;/CardContent&gt;
+       &lt;/Card&gt;
+     &lt;/motion.div&gt;
+   )
+ }
+
```

```diff
+ /**
+  * TokenCounter - Component for estimating token usage in text
+  *
+  * This component provides a simple token count estimator for AI text,
+  * helping monitor token usage for API calls.
+  */
+ 'use client'
+ 
+ import {useMemo} from 'react'
+ import {Info} from 'lucide-react'
+ import {Tooltip, TooltipContent, TooltipProvider, TooltipTrigger} from '@/components/ui/tooltip'
+ import {cn} from '@/lib/utils'
+ 
+ interface TokenCounterProps {
+   text: string
+   className?: string
+   tooltipContent?: string
+   showLabel?: boolean
+   maxTokens?: number
+ }
+ 
+ // Simple token counting approximation
+ // More accurate tokenizers are available but might be too heavy for client-side
+ function estimateTokenCount(text: string): number {
+   if (!text) return 0
+ 
+   // A rough approximation - GPT models use ~4 chars per token on average
+   // This is not exact but gives a reasonable estimate for monitoring
+   const charCount = text.length
+   const tokenEstimate = Math.ceil(charCount / 4)
+ 
+   return tokenEstimate
+ }
+ 
+ export function TokenCounter({
+   text,
+   className = '',
+   tooltipContent = 'Estimated token count (approximate)',
+   showLabel = false,
+   maxTokens,
+ }: TokenCounterProps) {
+   const tokenCount = useMemo(() =&gt; estimateTokenCount(text), [text])
+ 
+   // Calculate percentage of max tokens if maxTokens is provided
+   const percentUsed = maxTokens ? (tokenCount / maxTokens) * 100 : undefined
+ 
+   // Determine color based on usage
+   const getColorClass = () =&gt; {
+     if (!percentUsed) return ''
+     if (percentUsed &gt; 90) return 'text-red-500'
+     if (percentUsed &gt; 70) return 'text-amber-500'
+     return ''
+   }
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;TooltipProvider&gt;
+       &lt;Tooltip&gt;
+         &lt;TooltipTrigger asChild&gt;
+           &lt;div
+             className={cn(
+               'flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground',
+               getColorClass(),
+               className
+             )}&gt;
+             {showLabel &amp;&amp; &lt;span&gt;Tokens:&lt;/span&gt;}
+ 
+             &lt;span className='font-mono'&gt;
+               {tokenCount.toLocaleString()}
+               {maxTokens ? &#96; / ${maxTokens.toLocaleString()}&#96; : ''}
+             &lt;/span&gt;
+ 
+             &lt;Info className='h-3 w-3 opacity-50' /&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;/TooltipTrigger&gt;
+         &lt;TooltipContent side='top' align='center' className='text-xs max-w-56'&gt;
+           &lt;p&gt;{tooltipContent}&lt;/p&gt;
+           {maxTokens &amp;&amp; &lt;p className='mt-1'&gt;{percentUsed?.toFixed(1)}% of max token limit used&lt;/p&gt;}
+         &lt;/TooltipContent&gt;
+       &lt;/Tooltip&gt;
+     &lt;/TooltipProvider&gt;
+   )
+ }
+
```

```diff
+ /**
+  * Text Effects - Components for animated text displays
+  *
+  * This file contains a collection of animated text effect components
+  * that can be used to enhance the visual presentation of agent UIs.
+  */
+ 'use client'
+ 
+ import React, {useState, useEffect, useRef} from 'react'
+ import {motion, AnimatePresence} from 'motion/react'
+ import {cn} from '@/lib/utils'
+ 
+ // Text Roll animation - creates a slot-machine like effect
+ interface TextRollProps {
+   children: string
+   className?: string
+   duration?: number
+ }
+ 
+ export function TextRoll({children, className = '', duration = 1.5}: TextRollProps) {
+   const [displayText, setDisplayText] = useState('')
+   const isFirstRun = useRef(true)
+ 
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     if (isFirstRun.current) {
+       isFirstRun.current = false
+       setDisplayText(children)
+       return
+     }
+ 
+     // Create revealing animation
+     let currentIndex = 0
+     const targetText = children.toString()
+     const interval = Math.min(70, (duration * 1000) / targetText.length)
+ 
+     const timer = setInterval(() =&gt; {
+       if (currentIndex &lt;= targetText.length) {
+         setDisplayText(targetText.substring(0, currentIndex))
+         currentIndex++
+       } else {
+         clearInterval(timer)
+       }
+     }, interval)
+ 
+     return () =&gt; clearInterval(timer)
+   }, [children, duration])
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;motion.div
+       initial={{opacity: 0}}
+       animate={{opacity: 1}}
+       className={cn('font-mono', className)}&gt;
+       {displayText}
+       {displayText.length &lt; children.toString().length &amp;&amp; (
+         &lt;motion.span
+           animate={{opacity: [1, 0]}}
+           transition={{repeat: Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY, duration: 0.8}}
+           className='inline-block ml-0.5'&gt;
+           _
+         &lt;/motion.span&gt;
+       )}
+     &lt;/motion.div&gt;
+   )
+ }
+ 
+ // Simple text effect with staggered animation for each character
+ interface TextEffectProps {
+   children: string
+   className?: string
+   staggerDelay?: number
+ }
+ 
+ export function TextEffect({children, className = '', staggerDelay = 0.03}: TextEffectProps) {
+   const characters = children.split('')
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;span className={className}&gt;
+       {characters.map((char, index) =&gt; (
+         &lt;motion.span
+           key={&#96;${char}-${index}&#96;}
+           initial={{opacity: 0, y: 5}}
+           animate={{opacity: 1, y: 0}}
+           transition={{delay: index * staggerDelay, duration: 0.3}}
+           className='inline-block'&gt;
+           {char === ' ' ? '\u00A0' : char}
+         &lt;/motion.span&gt;
+       ))}
+     &lt;/span&gt;
+   )
+ }
+ 
+ // Typewriter effect for simulating typing
+ interface TypewriterProps {
+   text: string
+   speed?: number
+   delay?: number
+   className?: string
+   loop?: boolean
+   cursor?: boolean
+ }
+ 
+ export function Typewriter({
+   text,
+   speed = 70,
+   delay = 0,
+   className = '',
+   loop = false,
+   cursor = true,
+ }: TypewriterProps) {
+   const [displayText, setDisplayText] = useState('')
+   const [isTyping, setIsTyping] = useState(false)
+   const timeoutRef = useRef&lt;NodeJS.Timeout | null&gt;(null)
+ 
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     // Clear any existing timers
+     if (timeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current)
+ 
+     // Reset and start with delay
+     setDisplayText('')
+     setIsTyping(true)
+ 
+     timeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() =&gt; {
+       let index = 0
+ 
+       const typingInterval = setInterval(() =&gt; {
+         if (index &lt; text.length) {
+           setDisplayText((prev) =&gt; prev + text.charAt(index))
+           index++
+         } else {
+           clearInterval(typingInterval)
+           setIsTyping(false)
+ 
+           // Handle loop if enabled
+           if (loop) {
+             timeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() =&gt; {
+               setDisplayText('')
+               setIsTyping(true)
+             }, 2000) // Pause before restarting
+           }
+         }
+       }, speed)
+ 
+       return () =&gt; {
+         clearInterval(typingInterval)
+         if (timeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current)
+       }
+     }, delay)
+ 
+     return () =&gt; {
+       if (timeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current)
+     }
+   }, [text, speed, delay, loop])
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className={className}&gt;
+       &lt;span&gt;{displayText}&lt;/span&gt;
+       {(isTyping || cursor) &amp;&amp; (
+         &lt;motion.span
+           animate={{opacity: [1, 0]}}
+           transition={{repeat: Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY, duration: 0.8}}
+           className='inline-block ml-0.5'&gt;
+           |
+         &lt;/motion.span&gt;
+       )}
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   )
+ }
+ 
+ // Animated number counter
+ interface NumberCounterProps {
+   value: number
+   duration?: number
+   className?: string
+   prefix?: string
+   suffix?: string
+   decimals?: number
+ }
+ 
+ export function NumberCounter({
+   value,
+   duration = 1.5,
+   className = '',
+   prefix = '',
+   suffix = '',
+   decimals = 0,
+ }: NumberCounterProps) {
+   const [displayValue, setDisplayValue] = useState(0)
+   const previousValue = useRef(0)
+ 
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     const startValue = previousValue.current
+     const endValue = value
+     const startTime = Date.now()
+ 
+     const updateValue = () =&gt; {
+       const now = Date.now()
+       const elapsed = now - startTime
+       const progress = Math.min(elapsed / (duration * 1000), 1)
+ 
+       // Easing function for smooth animation
+       const easeOutQuad = (t: number) =&gt; t * (2 - t)
+       const easedProgress = easeOutQuad(progress)
+ 
+       const currentValue = startValue + (endValue - startValue) * easedProgress
+       setDisplayValue(currentValue)
+ 
+       if (progress &lt; 1) {
+         requestAnimationFrame(updateValue)
+       } else {
+         previousValue.current = endValue
+       }
+     }
+ 
+     updateValue()
+ 
+     return () =&gt; {
+       previousValue.current = displayValue
+     }
+   }, [value, duration])
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;span className={className}&gt;
+       {prefix}
+       {displayValue.toFixed(decimals)}
+       {suffix}
+     &lt;/span&gt;
+   )
+ }
+ 
+ // Glitch Text Effect
+ interface GlitchTextProps {
+   children: string
+   className?: string
+   intensity?: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high'
+   active?: boolean
+ }
+ 
+ export function GlitchText({
+   children,
+   className = '',
+   intensity = 'medium',
+   active = true,
+ }: GlitchTextProps) {
+   const [isGlitching, setIsGlitching] = useState(false)
+   const [displayText, setDisplayText] = useState(children)
+   const intervalRef = useRef&lt;NodeJS.Timeout | null&gt;(null)
+ 
+   // Define glitch intensity parameters
+   const glitchParams = {
+     low: {probability: 0.01, duration: 50, interval: 3000},
+     medium: {probability: 0.03, duration: 100, interval: 2000},
+     high: {probability: 0.08, duration: 150, interval: 1000},
+   }[intensity]
+ 
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     if (!active) {
+       setDisplayText(children)
+       if (intervalRef.current) clearInterval(intervalRef.current)
+       return
+     }
+ 
+     // Reset on children change
+     setDisplayText(children)
+ 
+     // Characters to use for glitching
+     const glitchChars = '!&lt;&gt;-_\\/@#$%^&amp;*()=+?[]{}~|'.split('')
+ 
+     // Periodically check if we should glitch
+     intervalRef.current = setInterval(() =&gt; {
+       if (Math.random() &lt; glitchParams.probability) {
+         setIsGlitching(true)
+ 
+         // Create glitched text
+         const originalText = children.toString()
+         let glitchedText = ''
+ 
+         for (let i = 0; i &lt; originalText.length; i++) {
+           // Randomly replace some characters
+           if (Math.random() &lt; 0.3) {
+             const randomChar = glitchChars[Math.floor(Math.random() * glitchChars.length)]
+             glitchedText += randomChar
+           } else {
+             glitchedText += originalText[i]
+           }
+         }
+ 
+         setDisplayText(glitchedText)
+ 
+         // Reset after short duration
+         setTimeout(() =&gt; {
+           setDisplayText(children)
+           setIsGlitching(false)
+         }, glitchParams.duration)
+       }
+     }, glitchParams.interval)
+ 
+     return () =&gt; {
+       if (intervalRef.current) clearInterval(intervalRef.current)
+     }
+   }, [children, active, intensity, glitchParams])
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;span
+       className={cn(
+         className,
+         isGlitching &amp;&amp;
+           'relative after:absolute after:inset-0 after:bg-blue-500/20 after:animate-pulse'
+       )}&gt;
+       {displayText}
+     &lt;/span&gt;
+   )
+ }
+
```

```diff
+ /**
+  * MarkdownRenderer - Component for rendering markdown content
+  *
+  * This component takes markdown text and renders it as formatted HTML,
+  * supporting code blocks, syntax highlighting, tables, and other markdown features.
+  */
+ 'use client'
+ 
+ import {useMemo} from 'react'
+ import ReactMarkdown from 'react-markdown'
+ import {Prism as SyntaxHighlighter} from 'react-syntax-highlighter'
+ import {nord as codeTheme} from 'react-syntax-highlighter/dist/esm/styles/prism'
+ import remarkGfm from 'remark-gfm'
+ import rehypeRaw from 'rehype-raw'
+ import {cn} from '@/lib/utils'
+ 
+ interface MarkdownRendererProps {
+   content: string
+   className?: string
+   codeClassName?: string
+ }
+ 
+ export function MarkdownRenderer({
+   content,
+   className = '',
+   codeClassName = '',
+ }: MarkdownRendererProps) {
+   // Process and clean the content before rendering
+   const processedContent = useMemo(() =&gt; {
+     if (!content) return ''
+ 
+     // Replace multiple newlines with maximum of two
+     const normalizedNewlines = content.replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n')
+ 
+     // Other content processing can be added here
+ 
+     return normalizedNewlines
+   }, [content])
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className={cn('markdown-renderer prose prose-sm dark:prose-invert max-w-none', className)}&gt;
+       &lt;ReactMarkdown
+         remarkPlugins={[remarkGfm]}
+         rehypePlugins={[rehypeRaw]}
+         components={{
+           // Customize code blocks with syntax highlighting
+           code({node, inline, className, children, ...props}) {
+             const match = /language-(\w+)/.exec(className || '')
+             const language = match ? match[1] : ''
+ 
+             return !inline ? (
+               &lt;div className='relative group'&gt;
+                 {language &amp;&amp; (
+                   &lt;div className='absolute right-3 top-2 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-xs bg-gray-700/50 text-gray-300'&gt;
+                     {language}
+                   &lt;/div&gt;
+                 )}
+                 &lt;SyntaxHighlighter
+                   style={codeTheme}
+                   language={language || 'text'}
+                   PreTag='div'
+                   className={cn('!mt-2 !rounded-md', codeClassName)}
+                   {...props}&gt;
+                   {String(children).replace(/\n$/, '')}
+                 &lt;/SyntaxHighlighter&gt;
+               &lt;/div&gt;
+             ) : (
+               &lt;code
+                 className={cn(
+                   'px-1.5 py-0.5 mx-0.5 rounded text-sm font-mono bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800',
+                   className
+                 )}
+                 {...props}&gt;
+                 {children}
+               &lt;/code&gt;
+             )
+           },
+ 
+           // Customize links to open in new tab and have proper styling
+           a({node, children, href, ...props}) {
+             return (
+               &lt;a
+                 href={href}
+                 target='_blank'
+                 rel='noopener noreferrer'
+                 className='text-blue-600 hover:underline'
+                 {...props}&gt;
+                 {children}
+               &lt;/a&gt;
+             )
+           },
+ 
+           // Customize tables for better styling
+           table({node, children, ...props}) {
+             return (
+               &lt;div className='overflow-x-auto my-4 border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 rounded-md'&gt;
+                 &lt;table
+                   className='min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-200 dark:divide-gray-700'
+                   {...props}&gt;
+                   {children}
+                 &lt;/table&gt;
+               &lt;/div&gt;
+             )
+           },
+ 
+           // Style table headers
+           thead({node, children, ...props}) {
+             return (
+               &lt;thead className='bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800' {...props}&gt;
+                 {children}
+               &lt;/thead&gt;
+             )
+           },
+ 
+           // Style table cells
+           td({node, children, ...props}) {
+             return (

+                 {children}
```

I've created all the requested files for the agent patterns components. Here's a summary of what I've created:

   - `completion-indicator.tsx`: Visual indicator for AI task completion
   - `token-counter.tsx`: Estimates token usage in AI content
   - `markdown-renderer.tsx`: Renders markdown with syntax highlighting
   - `effects.tsx`: Collection of text animation components

4. **Index File**:

All components are built with a consistent design language, React best practices, and include proper TypeScript types. The components work together to create a cohesive agent interface system.
